verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's docs say merchants can generate a payment link in the Mercado Pago app or website and share it anywhere, with no website required, which is a no-code shareable link. A separate claim says accounts open in minutes, supporting a fast start. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the link-creation workflow (customization, amounts, payment methods on the link), explicit confirmation that selling can begin immediately without account verification delays, independent or hands-on corroboration.
